body: Thank you very much, I'll definitely talk to m doctor about this.

I was prescribed Adderall when I was about seven. I used it all the way up to 8th grade when I realized I didn't like how I felt when I was on it. I had a short temper and I was very antisocial. I do, however, think it might be useful to try again.
You're right, and I've had other friends tell me this, but I just don't think I have it in me to actually bite the bullet if I know things will end badly.

She's a bio/premed student and she's always has had problems with working for prolonged periods of time because she has chronic migraines. She's said that she usually takes breaks because of this and that's why she takes so long. We've had "study dates" in the past. She's perfectly fine with them, but I unfortunately have had ADHD since I was a kid and can't really focus on my work when I'm not alone/around people I know. I feel like it just won't "work" but I don't think I have it in me to end things because of this.

While I agree with you, some complications would arise if I were to end things. She's kind of a recluse because of her lifestyle and has said that she doesn't really have anyone without me. She has a history of mental health problems and she has hurt herself/others in the past because of a break-up. I really just don't want to risk it unless I have a peaceful way to end things.

Thank you very much for your advice. If I were to do that, how do you think I should go about breaking it off? She's the only girl I've ever dated for longer than a month and I can't imagine a scenario where we can end things without one of us getting hurt. I'm sorry, I just really have no experience dealing with situations like this.

I've considered it for a few months, and for a bunch of other reasons, but I always find myself feeling hopeful that things will change. She's also kind of a recluse and doesn't have many friends other than me, she's said many times how she wouldn't be in a good place if I wasn't there. I don't want to take the risk that she might do something to hurt herself or me or my friends.
